description: We manufacture a powdered pharmaceutical blend containing an active ingredient and several excipients. We want to investigate whether near-infrared spectroscopy can monitor moisture and blend uniformity in-line during mixing. Moisture is typically 1–5% by mass, and the active ingredient concentration is approximately 10% by mass. Particle size and temperature vary between batches. We currently use Karl Fischer titration for moisture and HPLC for active ingredient concentration. Ideally, measurements should update every 10 seconds without removing samples. Which measurement approaches are worth investigating, what information is missing, and how should we design an initial feasibility experiment?
